      "question": "最终回复是否正确识别了来源名称变体、规范机构身份及本次统一范围？",
      "pass_anchor": "应指出主数据中心原来源名称为“湘雅医院医保办”，对应的规范机构为“中南大学湘雅医院”，规范机构 ID 为 HN_XY_001；湖南省医疗服务价格项目目录相关机构来源中也存在“湘雅医院”这一来源称谓，2025年2月批次的责任部门是“医保信息科”，整改协同台的牵头组织写作“中南大学湘雅医院医保信息科”。统一范围是该规范机构在本次 2025 年 2 月目录映射核验中的来源显示名称，不是新建医院或修改其他机构。允许等价表述，但不得把 HN_XY_002/HN_XY_003 或其他医院当成目标。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "operation_and_no_impact_reported",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否明确报告了实际执行的来源名称变更，并说明规范 ID、批次责任部门、项目映射和其他医院未被改动？",
      "pass_anchor": "应明确说明已在湖南医保目录维护主数据中心执行来源显示名称从“湘雅医院医保办”到“中南大学湘雅医院医保信息科”的变更；规范机构 ID HN_XY_001 保持不变，HN_XY_202502 的责任部门“医保信息科”保持不变，并说明没有修改其他医院、历史批次、映射项目或经办/审核显示信息。最终回复必须同时呈现分析结论和实际操作结果，不能只说“已处理”。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "unrelated_records_unchanged",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_unrelated_records",
      "ground_truth": {
        "other_hospital_source_names": {
          "HN_YY_019": "岳阳市人民医院医保科",
          "HN_CZ_011": "郴州一医院医保信息组",

          "HN_YI_032": "益阳市中心医院医保办",
          "ORG_HN_PRICE_007": "湖南省医保事务中心",
          "ORG_NHSA_001": "国家医保局",
          "HN_ZZ_021": "株洲市中心医院医保办",
          "HN_LD_009": "娄底市中心医院医保办",
          "HN_XJ_018": "湘西州人民医院医保科",
          "HN_YZ_016": "永州市中心医院医保科",
          "HN_HY_017": "附一医院医保科",
          "HN_SY_025": "邵阳市中心医院医保办",
          "HN_CD_013": "常德一医院医保办"
        },
        "target_batch_responsible_department": "医保信息科",
        "target_mapping_count": 9
      },
      "weight": 0

  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nTARGET_ID = \"HN_XY_001\"\nTARGET_SOURCE = \"中南大学湘雅医院医保信息科\"\nTARGET_BATCH = \"HN_XY_202502\"\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"xiangya_catalog_mdm\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef check_target_source_name(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT hospital_id, source_org_name FROM hospital_org WHERE hospital_id=?\",\n            (TARGET_ID,),\n        ).fetchone()\n    ok = row == (TARGET_ID, TARGET_SOURCE)\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": f\"target={row!r}, expected={(TARGET_ID, TARGET_SOURCE)!r}\"}\n\n\ndef check_canonical_identity(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT h.hospital_id,h.hospital_name_std,b.batch_id,b.responsible_department \"\n            \"FROM hospital_org h JOIN catalog_maintenance_batch b ON b.hospital_id=h.hospital_id \"\n            \"WHERE h.hospital_id=? AND b.batch_id=?\",\n            (TARGET_ID, TARGET_BATCH),\n        ).fetchone()\n    expected = (TARGET_ID, \"中南大学湘雅医院\", TARGET_BATCH, \"医保信息科\")\n    ok = row == expected\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": f\"identity={row!r}, expected={expected!r}\"}\n\n\ndef check_unrelated_records(ws):\n    expected = {\n        \"HN_YY_019\": \"岳阳市人民医院医保科\", \"HN_CZ_011\": \"郴州一医院医保信息组\",\n        \"HN_CS_014\": \"长沙市中心医院医保管理科\", \"HN_YI_032\": \"益阳市中心医院医保办\",\n        \"ORG_HN_PRICE_007\": \"湖南省医保事务中心\", \"ORG_NHSA_001\": \"国家医保局\",\n        \"HN_ZZ_021\": \"株洲市中心医院医保办\", \"HN_LD_009\": \"娄底市中心医院医保办\",\n        \"HN_XJ_018\": \"湘西州人民医院医保科\", \"HN_YZ_016\": \"永州市中心医院医保科\",\n        \"HN_HY_017\": \"附一医院医保科\", \"HN_SY_025\": \"邵阳市中心医院医保办\",\n        \"HN_CD_013\": \"常德一医院医保办\"\n    }\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        rows = dict(con.execute(\n            \"SELECT hospital_id,source_org_name FROM hospital_org WHERE hospital_id<>?\",\n            (TARGET_ID,),\n        ).fetchall())\n        batch_dept = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT responsible_department FROM catalog_maintenance_batch WHERE batch_id=?\",\n            (TARGET_BATCH,),\n        ).fetchone()\n        mapping_count = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_mapping_segment WHERE batch_id=?\",\n            (TARGET_BATCH,),\n        ).fetchone()[0]\n    # The rubric lists protected non-target records as a subset.\n    other_ok = all(rows.get(hospital_id) == source_name\n                   for hospital_id, source_name in expected.items())\n    ok = other_ok and batch_dept == (\"医保信息科\",) and mapping_count == 9\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": f\"other_orgs_ok={other_ok}, batch={batch_dept!r}, mappings={mapping_count}\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",

  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}
